summary: Frontend-only validation of the new 'Proyectos Directos Multi-RIF' wizard in /direct-projects. All 7 user-confirmed UX scenarios validated end-to-end via Playwright with admin rgonzalez@megasoft.com.ve. No project was actually submitted (per agent note); validation focused on render, conditional sections, sponsorship branching, strict box matching, and shared-matrix toggle behavior.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warnings in console: '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' coming from notification/router layout. Not introduced by Multi-RIF feature but should be cleaned up by main agent in a follow-up.

critical_code_review_comments: DirectProjectCreation.jsx is ~1410 lines — consider splitting into smaller modules (Definicion Comercial, Hardware, Tech Config, Reel, Multi-RIF) for maintainability.
Pre-existing hydration warning in App shell about invalid <tr>/<span> nesting; unrelated to Multi-RIF but visible in every screenshot. Worth fixing in a separate cleanup.
seed_data_creation: None. NO project was created/submitted; just rendered the form and validated enablement/disablement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 Multi-RIF UX rules validated: (1) Type selector card with dp-type-simple/dp-type-multirif renders with default 'simple'. (2) In Simple mode dp-multistore-toggle and dp-boxes-grid (Reel) are visible; dp-multirif-card NOT present. (3) Clicking dp-type-multirif: dp-multirif-card with dp-shared-matrix-toggle becomes visible, dp-multistore-toggle is hidden. (4) Sponsorship bifurcation dp-multirif-sponsorship with dp-sponsorship-bank/dp-sponsorship-client toggles dp-sponsor-bank visibility (bank=visible, client=hidden) as expected. (5) Full flow with shared_matrix=true: selected client 'BANCO NACIONAL DE CREDITO', cantidad_cajas=4, client-sponsored, RIF with 4 cajas + 2 stores (2+2), server 'Multicomercio MSC', SSL, added reel bank/product → dp-errors not visible, dp-submit-btn enabled. (6) Strict matching: with stores 2+1=3 vs RIF 4 → dp-errors visible, dp-multirif-store-warning visible, dp-submit-btn disabled; corrected to 2+2 → warning cleared. (7) Toggling shared-matrix OFF after adding a RIF → dp-boxes-grid hidden, dp-multirif-matrix-block visible with one dp-rif-matrix-* containing dp-rif-bank-* select and dp-rif-add-* button; per-RIF validation error 'BNC: define bancos/productos para este RIF' appears as expected. Backend already validated by main agent (pytest 4/4) so not retested.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in feature scope.
